contentBlocks.body: Destructuring pulls properties out of an object into local variables. Doing it right in the parameter list, like function f({ first, last }), keeps a function readable when it only needs a few keys.

knowledgeItems.prompt: What does function fullName({ first, last }) do with its argument?

choices: pulls the first and last properties into local variables
payload.answer: pulls the first and last properties into local variables
payload.explanation: Destructuring in the parameter list binds the named properties of the passed object.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Using object destructuring, return the full name as 'first last'.
